events.title: 🎉Steam Next Fest: New Characters in Saintess Anno Demo Update!
events.summary: To celebrate the upcoming Steam Next Fest, our demo has received a massive update! This update introduces our second combat character and our second support character, bringing you richer team compositions and strategic experiences!Update the game now and experience these brand-new combat combinations!🗡️ New Combat Character: Shangguan Yan"Once dreamed of wandering the world with a sword. Later, the family fell, and the horse was gone." Since the horse is gone, let's carve a path with the sword

events.title: Demo 0.10.11 Minor Patch
events.summary: Added crash error prompts to make it easier to report issues. Thanks for your support; the developer will fix them as soon as possible.Fixed an issue where the first hero's talent could not synergize with Ultimate-type cards.Adjusted the logic code for the Backpack, Settings, BOSS, and buttons.Greatly optimized the early-game difficulty.

events.title: Demo 0.10.10 Minor Patch
